summary.text: Jack Kolbeck is a Republican state representative who has represented South Dakota House District 13 since his appointment in February 2025 and is seeking election on November 3, 2026.
A former state senator, he faces Democrat Ali Horsted, along with fellow Republican incumbent John Hughes, for the district's two seats, according to Ballotpedia.

paragraphs.text: Jack Kolbeck earned a bachelor's degree in economics and political science from South Dakota State University in 1974, and Ballotpedia lists his career experience as including work as a key accounts manager for Beal Distributing.
Ballotpedia reports that Kolbeck won elections to South Dakota State Senate District 13 in 2018, 2020 and 2022, defeating Melissa Hiatt, Liz Larson and Lora Hubbel respectively.
It says he was appointed to the House on February 5, 2025, to replace Tony Venhuizen, and lists his 2025-2026 committee assignment as House Appropriations.
